How We Work

The Four-Step Turnkey Process

From first survey to final building control sign-off, every stage of your project is communicated clearly and built with pride.

01

Initial Survey & Consultation

We visit your Wednesbury property to review requirements, measure spaces, and provide transparent advice on feasibility.

02

3D Design & Fixed Scope

Full 3D visualization, detailed architectural drawings, and an itemised fixed-price contract with zero hidden costs.

03

Master Trades On-Site

Dedicated team of time-served bricklayers, joiners, and electricians working cleanly from 8:00 AM daily.

04

Building Regs Handover

Complete building control compliance certificate, structural guarantees, and turnkey handover of your new space.

Frequently Asked Questions

Clear Answers Before We Start

Everything you need to know about working with Simplicity Design & Fit Ltd.

Do you handle planning permission and building regulations?

Yes. We handle all architectural plans, structural calculations, and building control applications through to full sign-off.

Are your quotes fixed in price before work begins?

Yes. Every quotation is fully itemised with a fixed-price schedule of works. You know exactly what is included from day one.

What areas across the West Midlands do you cover?

We are based on Mounts Road in Wednesbury (WS10) and manage projects across Wednesbury, Walsall, Cannock, and the wider West Midlands.

Can we live in our home during a major kitchen or extension build?

In most cases, yes. We erect temporary dust seals, maintain temporary cooking facilities where possible, and clean the site thoroughly at the end of each working day.
